description.en: Opens the official chat.deepseek.com page in the DSH main panel through the desktop app's native browser, so the login survives restarts; no iframe and no request proxying. A fork of JaMoLpE88/dsh-desktop-chat with the changes listed in its NOTICE.
description.zh: 在 DSH 主面板里用桌面端原生浏览器打开 chat.deepseek.com 官方网页，登录可跨重启恢复，不用 iframe、不代理请求；基于 JaMoLpE88/dsh-desktop-chat 的 fork，改动见 NOTICE。
